newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 rises to new record after rate rise.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 rises to new record after rate rise.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index rose back through the 4,500 level as markets welcomed new Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's decision to raise interest rates and grant a degree of independence to the Bank of England.

The blue chip index, up just 17 points before Brown's comments, had surged 56.2 points to a record 4,511.8 by 1040 GMT, surpassing its previous peak set in early trading on Tuesday on the back of recent gains on Wall Street.
Strategists said Brown's announcement lent credibility to the Labour government's anti-inflation credintials since its return to power in an election last week.
